premises.text: Diabetes is an incurable disease that complicates blood sugar management.
premises.evidence_span: Diabetes is an incurable disease that affects a person's ability to produce or react to insulin enslaving us to a life of blood sugar management and insulin injections like this one or this one.

premises.text: Current diabetes management tools require manual logging and analysis.
premises.evidence_span: Yet all they do is provide us with fancy tools so that we can do hard work of logging details and then manually analyzing them or sharing them.

premises.text: Spike automatically collects details about a user's life and provides insulin tips and reminders.
premises.evidence_span: By automatically collecting details about your life your routine your activity and your vitals spike proactively provides you with the right Insulin tips and reminders with food suggestions.

premises.text: Spike can alert users to check their sugar levels based on detected activity and stress.
premises.evidence_span: Spike alerts her to check her sugar because she might be going through hypoglycemia now by scanning one of the patches that we support.

premises.text: Spike provides food suggestions with approximate carb counts when users enter food locations.
premises.evidence_span: as soon as she would enter McDonald's She would automatically get the top three food options. She would have with approximate carb count.

premises.text: Spike informs guardians and doctors in real-time about the user's situation.
premises.evidence_span: As for her Guardians and doctors they are informed in real time about her situation.

premises.text: Spike is free for diabetics, funded by insurance companies and employers.
